The Team

Fullstack builds the internal software the rest of Pi runs on. title: 端侧 DevOps 工程师（机器人方向）

fields.full_description:
岗位职责
1、搭建和优化机器人研发全流程 CI/CD 流水线，实现算法、控制程序、固件及 ROS/ROS2 代码的自动化构建、测试、打包和端侧部署；
2、设计、开发并维护自动化工具与脚本，提升研发效率并保证交付稳定性；
3、整合 CI/CD 工具链（GitLab、Jenkins等）与仿真平台（Isaac Sim、Gazebo），实现端到端流程自动化和工具联动；
4、负责制品库建设与管理，包括镜像/软件包的版本策略、生命周期管理、清理机制和可回滚方案，确保研发制品可追溯、可靠发布；
5、监控流水线运行状态，快速定位构建、部署及机器人端问题，确保研发交付顺畅；
6、推动自动化测试、灰度发布、固件回滚等最佳实践，优化研发流程并提供团队培训与支持；
7、跟踪前沿 DevOps 技术（云原生 CI/CD、GitOps、DevSecOps），结合多机器人和端云协同场景持续改进交付体系。

任职要求
1、本科及以上学历，计算机、软件工程、电子信息或机器人相关专业，3 年以上 DevOps / CI/CD 或研发效能经验，有机器人研发经验优先；
2、精通至少一种脚本/编程语言（Shell、Python、Go），能够独立开发自动化脚本与工具；
3、熟悉主流 CI/CD 工具及流程，能搭建适配复杂研发场景的流水线；
4、熟悉容器化和云原生技术（Docker、Podman 或 K8s），了解镜像管理、环境编排及端侧部署优化；
5、熟悉制品库/Registry 管理（Harbor、Nexus、GitLab Registry 等），能够制定版本策略、清理机制和发布规范；
6、对机器人研发流程（ROS/ROS2、算法、固件、硬件调试）有一定理解，具备问题分析与排查能力；
7、具备良好沟通、协作能力，能适应快速迭代的研发节奏。

fields.duties:
岗位职责：

1、参与具身智能机器人本体侧应用软件开发，接入并集成语音识别、语音合成、大模型、多模态模型等 AI 能力，实现机器人对话、主动交互、任务理解、情绪反馈等功能。 

2、基于通用智能体的开发模式，参与机器人 Agent 相关功能实现，包括工具调用、任务拆解、上下文管理、执行反馈、动作触发等模块开发。

 3、根据产品和交互需求，实现语音、文本、动作、表情、灯效、屏幕等多模态交互能力，使机器人在真实场景中具备更自然的交互体验。

 4、参与机器人端应用系统的性能分析和优化，包括响应延迟、启动速度、运行稳定性、CPU / 内存占用、音频链路、模型调用链路、并发任务调度等方面的优化。

 5、参与机器人整机联调，包括传感器接入、音频设备调试、运动控制接口联调、应用 Demo 验证、真实场景测试和问题排查。 

6、参与将原型 Demo 转化为稳定产品功能的过程，包括代码重构、接口规范化、日志完善、异常兜底、配置管理、部署适配和测试验证。 

7、与算法、硬件、产品、测试团队协作，完成需求理解、技术实现、问题复现、缺陷修复和版本迭代。 




任职要求：

1、本科及以上学历，计算机、机器人、自动化、电子信息、人工智能等相关专业。

 2、具备较扎实的机器人或智能硬件开发经验，能够独立完成应用模块开发、调试和问题定位，并配合硬件团队完成联调。

3、熟悉 Linux 开发环境，熟悉常见的软件工程开发流程，具备良好的代码质量意识。

4、熟悉 ROS / ROS2，理解节点通信、Topic、Service、Action、消息机制、状态机等常见开发方式，并有实际项目使用经验。 

5、熟练掌握 Python 和 C++，能够完成机器人应用层逻辑开发、模块封装、接口适配和系统集成。 

6、熟悉大模型应用开发的基本方式，熟悉通用智能体的基本方法论和开发模式，具备一定系统性能优化经验。 

7、对具身智能、服务机器人、陪伴机器人、人机交互或多模态交互方向有兴趣，愿意深入真实机器人系统开发。 




加分项

熟悉 TypeScript，有 Node.js、前端工具、机器人控制台、调试平台、可视化界面或 Agent 应用开发经验者优先。 

熟悉 Rust，有高性能模块、异步任务、系统工具、嵌入式 Linux、通信组件或机器人底层模块开发经验者优先。

熟悉 Linux 音频系统，了解 ALSA / PulseAudio / PipeWire / PCM 设备，有麦克风采集、音频播放、回声消除、降噪、唤醒、ASR / TTS 链路调试经验者优先。 

有机器人、智能硬件、边缘 AI 设备、IoT 设备或嵌入式 Linux 项目经验者优先。 

有从技术 Demo 到可交付产品功能的开发经验者优先。

有大模型应用、AI Agent、多模态交互、语音交互、数字人、情感计算或社交机器人相关项目经验者优先。 

熟悉 Docker、CI/CD、自动化测试、远程日志、性能监控等工程化工具者优先。 

有机器人比赛、科研项目、开源项目或个人机器人项目经验者优先。

Description
Help us build the software stack underneath Frontier AI & Robotics: the layer between hardware and the AI policies running on it. You’ll work end-to-end across the stack, from bringing up sensors and actuators at the HW/SW boundary, to hardening the multi-process runtime that ties them together, to shipping the framework changes that let the rest of the team move faster.
This is a generalist role with a real systems edge. We need someone equally at home down at the sensor and OS boundary (drivers, IPC, real-time behavior, profiling) and up in robotics application code (most of it Python). You’ll spend stretches of a few days to a few weeks each on things like bringing up a new sensor at the protocol layer, chasing a flaky USB camera at the kernel boundary, generalizing the camera stack, cutting perception latency, porting code onto edge compute, or chasing a DDS/ROS 2 performance regression.
You’ll work with sharp, motivated engineers across hardware, ML research, controls, and ops on continuously changing problems at the frontier of AI and robotics. The role rewards engineers who communicate clearly, invest in cross-team relationships, and ship.
Key job responsibilities
- Bring up and integrate sensors, actuators, and edge compute across diverse robotics hardware platforms.
- Build and improve the multi-process Python and ROS 2 runtime: process management, IPC, observability, lifecycle.
- Diagnose and fix bottlenecks across the stack: middleware performance (DDS, ROS 2), perception pipeline latency, edge inference throughput, system-level resource contention.
- Generalize one-off solutions into reusable infrastructure (camera stacks, telemetry pipelines, edge deployment tooling) that scales across hardware platforms and use cases.
- Port code onto the constrained edge-compute platforms our robots run. Make it work, then make it work well.
- Identify gaps in the team’s velocity, whether that’s a missing piece of infrastructure or a fragile sensor that nobody has time to fix, and close them.
- Make proper tradeoffs between prototyping and production software.
About the team
At Frontier AI & Robotics, we're not just advancing robotics – we're reimagining it from the ground up. Our team is building the future of intelligent robotics through frontier foundation models and end-to-end learned systems. We tackle some of the most challenging problems in AI and robotics, from developing sophisticated perception systems to creating adaptive manipulation strategies that work in complex, real-world scenarios.
What sets us apart is our unique combination of ambitious research vision and practical impact. We leverage Amazon's massive computational infrastructure and rich real-world datasets to train and deploy state-of-the-art foundation models. Our work spans the full spectrum of robotics intelligence – from multimodal perception using images, videos, and sensor data, to sophisticated manipulation strategies that can handle diverse real-world scenarios. We're building systems that don't just work in the lab, but scale to meet the demands of Amazon's global operations.
Join us if you're excited about pushing the boundaries of what's possible in robotics, working with world-class researchers, and seeing your innovations deployed at unprecedented scale.
Basic Qualifications
- Bachelor's degree in computer science or equivalent
- 5+ years of software development experience
- Experience with C++/Python interop or other hybrid-language stacks.
- Experience as a tech lead, mentor, or technical owner of an engineering team or significant component. Experience designing and shipping software systems that run across distributed processes, edge devices, or real-time constraints.
- Experience working closely with hardware, ML, or controls teams as the software counterpart.
Preferred Qualifications
- Experience with low-level driver work and sensor bring-up across protocols (I2C, SPI, USB, MIPI, CAN).
- Experience optimizing data plane performance: DDS tuning, kernel networking, shared memory IPC, real-time scheduling.
- Experience with ROS 2 or other robotics middleware in production.
- Experience deploying ML inference at the edge under latency and memory constraints.
- Experience with multi-process Python lifecycles and writing performant Python (asyncio, multiprocessing, NumPy/JAX vectorization, GIL-aware design).
- Web application or full-stack web experience is a bonus.

Job Summary
Boston Dynamics Consulting exists to help make remarkably capable robots commonplace in the physical world. The Senior Consultant – Software Engineering is critical to the growth of our core business and products by working directly with customers and internal teams to develop software solutions that help our Fortune 500 & high value customers do more with our existing robotics products and achieve their automation and data needs using our products. To do this, you will build in-depth knowledge of our robotics & software solutions and demonstrate the ability to think strategically and develop software solutions that achieve our customers’ needs, while also contributing knowledge and code back to our core platforms and architectures.
The Senior Consultant works directly with external clients and project leadership on paid engagements to execute the development and delivery of software integrations and tools, and should have experience in projects related to customization of our core platforms, application development, sensor fusion, or other custom software development. They will learn from and synthesize insights from our customers, Consulting leaders, product leaders and external experts to successfully deliver applications and code that unlock robotics systems in the customer environments.
Key Responsibilities
Support Project Directors & Software Leaders to develop and deliver custom software solutions based on our core robot and fleet management products to accelerate the adoption of robotics & intelligent systems in dynamic environments.
Act as an external-facing technical representative, leveraging deep product knowledge to synthesize customer insights into actionable technical solutions and custom applications
Own the design and implementation of software frameworks that scale across autonomous systems, embedded platforms, and cloud-based services.
Drive resolution of complex, high-risk technical challenges in projects that span perception, planning, controls, safety, and hardware/software integration
Collaborate with cross-functional teams to gather data and insights in support of strategic initiatives.
Prepare executive-level presentations and technical documentation that summarize key findings and deliverables.
Assist in facilitating technical requirements and sprint planning sessions.
Move fast, but intentionally, to bring new technology tools that help guide our investments in core robotics / software capabilities, tools, and infrastructure
Stay informed on industry developments and share insights with relevant stakeholders.
Core Competencies
Execution
Owns delivery of impactful software solutions & technical planning. Ensures alignment across complex interdependent systems. Analyzes and prioritizes development and uses the most effective and efficient processes to get things done and achieve results, even under tough circumstances.
Collaboration
Cultivates high-trust relationships with senior technical leaders and executives. Builds consensus across diverse perspectives and functions to move client projects forward on key technical decisions, while creating a feedback loop to our core products.
Innovation
Synthesizes trends, theory, and practice to deliver novel software solutions or capabilities that help clients achieve positive impact from deploying robots in complex, real world scenarios.
Adaptability
Adapts and pivots in real time to match the shifting demands of different situations, and to move forward productively and optimistically under conditions of change and ambiguity.
Knowledge, Skills & Abilities
Expertise in Software development, software tools, and new platforms and tools for physical AI.
Knowledge or experience in robotics (especially our core platforms), autonomy, embedded systems, perception systems, or related fields.
Strong grasp of hardware/software trade-offs and cross-disciplinary systems thinking.
Ability to distill complex information into clear, actionable requirements.
Organized and detail-oriented, with strong problem-solving capabilities.
Typical Qualifications
Bachelor’s, Master’s, or Ph.D. in Computer Science, Robotics, Engineering, or a related field.
5+ years of experience in robotics or physical systems software engineering or embedded systems development.
Experience working in cross-functional teams in a matrixed environment preferred.
We are interested in every qualified candidate who is eligible to work in the United States. However, we are not able to sponsor visas for this position.
The base pay range for this position is between $134,399.00 to $167,998.00 annually. Base pay will depend on multiple individualized factors, including, but not limited to, internal equity, job-related knowledge, skills and experience. This range represents a good faith estimate of compensation at the time of posting. Boston Dynamics offers a generous Benefits package including medical, dental vision, 401(k), paid time off and a annual bonus structure. Additional details regarding these benefit plans will be provided if an employee receives an offer for employment.

FieldAI’s Irvine team is where embodied AI meets real robots, real sensors, and real field deployments. Based in the heart of Southern California’s robotics ecosystem, we build risk-aware, reliable, field-ready AI systems that solve the hardest problems in robotics and unlock the full potential of embodied intelligence. If you want your work to ship, get tested on hardware, and improve through real deployments, Irvine is the place. We go beyond typical data-driven approaches or pure transformer-only architectures, combining rigorous engineering with learning systems proven in globally deployed solutions that deliver results today and get better every time our robots run in the field.


What You Will Get To Do
Design, build, and maintain core infrastructure components such as CI/CD pipelines, build systems, monitoring tools, and deployment frameworks.
Develop and implement scalable solutions for service reliability, observability, and performance.
Collaborate with development teams to optimize infrastructure for high availability and fault tolerance.
Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using tools like Ansible or similar.
Improve system efficiency by automating recurring tasks and eliminating manual processes.
Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and ensure optimal uptime and security.
Maintain and enforce best practices in system design, security, and code quality.

What You Have
Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field (or equivalent work experience).
3+ years of experience in software engineering, DevOps, or infrastructure roles.
Strong programming/scripting skills in languages such as Python, TypeScript, or similar.
Experience with cloud platforms (AWS, GCP, Azure) and container orchestration.
Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code tools (AWS CDK, etc.).
Knowledge of monitoring and logging systems (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, Sentry).
Solid understanding of networking, Linux systems, and security best practices.
Excellent problem-solving skills and the ability to work collaboratively in a team environment.

What Will Set You Apart
Familiarity with robotics systems or infrastructure to support robotic applications (e.g., ROS, real-time systems, sensor integration).
Exposure to distributed systems and microservices architectures.
Background in site reliability engineering (SRE) practices.

Our salary range is generous and we consider each individual’s background and experience when determining final compensation. Base pay may vary based on role scope, job-related knowledge, skills, experience, and the Irvine, California market.
 
Why Join FieldAI in Irvine?
In Irvine, you will work where the robots are. Our local team builds and tests systems on real hardware with real sensors, then ships them to operate in unstructured, previously unknown environments around the world. We are solving one of robotics’ hardest challenges: reliable deployment outside the lab. Our Field Foundational Models™ raise the bar for perception, planning, localization, and manipulation, with an emphasis on explainability and safety for real-world use.
You will collaborate with a world-class team that thrives on creativity, resilience, and bold thinking. We bring deep experience from organizations such as DeepMind, NASA JPL, Boston Dynamics, NVIDIA, Amazon, Tesla Autopilot, Cruise, Zoox, Toyota Research Institute, and SpaceX, along with a track record of field deployments and strong performance in DARPA challenge segments.
 
Be Part of the Next Robotics Revolution
We are looking for builders who want their work to leave the whiteboard and show up on robots. If you enjoy tackling tough, uncharted questions and working across disciplines, you will find your people here. Our teams span AI, software, robotics engineering, product, field deployment, and technical communication, all focused on shipping systems that perform in the real world.
 
Our headquarters is in Irvine, and we partner closely with teams there as well as colleagues across the US and around the world. Join us in Southern California and help define what dependable, field-ready autonomy looks like.
 
We value diverse perspectives and are committed to fostering an inclusive workplace. We evaluate candidates and employees based on merit, qualifications, and performance, and we do not discriminate on the basis of race, color, gender, national origin, ethnicity, veteran status, disability status, age, sexual orientation, gender identity, marital status, or any other legally protected status.
